name: VisualNodeSystem
description: This library provides a powerful framework for creating and managing visual node systems.

paragraphs: This library provides a powerful framework for creating and managing visual node systems. These are typically used in graphical programming environments, game logic builders, and AI behavior tree editors.
The library draws everything through Dear ImGui and does not depend on a specific graphics API.
features: Unchanged Dear ImGui: This project does not depend on modifications to Dear ImGui.
Zoom: Zoom functionality enables detailed viewing and efficient navigation. The font system ensures precise text rendering at various zoom levels.
